idea: Letters & first words #2 – Letter B (PLAYROOM): a big chunky blue foam letter B pops up beside Baby Jimmy's face ('Wow! Look! A big letter B!'); chorus 'B, B, B! Buh, buh, buh!'; 'B is for ball! Bounce, bounce, bounce!' (red ball); 'B is for bear! Wave to the bear!' (brown teddy bear); copy-me 'Bounce with me!'; the B, the ball and the bear in a row – 'What starts with B? Hmm?' (pause) – 'Ball! Bear! B! Yay!'; lesson 'B says buh, buh, buh!'. title: Wow! A Big Letter B! 🔵 B Is for Ball & Bear | Learn ABC with Baby Jimmy | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A big blue letter B pops up right next to Baby Jimmy! 🔵 Sing along with Baby Jimmy and learn the letter B, its sound "buh" and two B words: ball and bear.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A big letter B!"
🔤 B, B, B! Buh, buh, buh!
🔴 B is for ball! Bounce, bounce, bounce!
🧸 B is for bear! Wave to the bear!
🤔 "What starts with B?" – can you answer?
👋 B says buh, buh, buh! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: the letter B • the B sound "buh" • ball • bear • first words for toddlers

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along ABC song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Jimmy in the Crayon Babies playroom learning the letter B with a bouncy red ball and a soft teddy bear.
